reason: I already pay for Jobber and the schedule and invoices are sorted in the evenings. I'm not paying $99 a month for something that has zero paying customers outside its own owner, and I'm not rebuilding my workflow to be a guinea pig.
objection: It's unproven. It runs in one company, the owner's own, and nobody outside has paid for it. $99 only makes sense if it actually brings in booked jobs, and nothing here shows that. Saving me a bit of time doesn't cover it.
would_change_my_mind: It works inside Jobber without me switching, and I see real numbers from a few outside companies like mine on how many extra booked jobs it brought. Or I pay only per booked job.
